english_evidence: Aggregator autorijschooltarieven.nl lists "Taal: Nederlands" (language: Dutch) and the official site is Dutch-only with no English page; it is a one-man (eenmans) rijschool.
price_signal: Pakket A (12 uur + examen) €897,50; Pakket B (18 uur + examen) €1227,50
waitlist_signal: Official site advertises "Geen lange wachttijden voor praktijkexamens" (no long wait times for practical exams)
notes: One-man (eenmans) driving school run by instructor Marco van der Ven, active in the Bommelerwaard and 's-Hertogenbosch/Den Bosch region; CBR exams at Den Bosch. Specialised in candidates with faalangst (test anxiety), autism and ADHD. Founding is explicit and consistent: official site states "bestaat sinds 2009" and "Even voorstellen" states "sinds 1 januari 2009 als zelfstandig rijschoolhouder". Offers A (motor), B (car), BE/B+ (trailer); historically also C/D mentioned by aggregators. Google rating shows as 0.0/5 on clickdrive (placeholder, no scraped average) over 55 reviews, so numeric rating left null. No evidence of English-language instruction.
